svg.title: Iterative Dual-RL (IDRL)
svg.desc: In a grid world, an offline dataset contains good, detouring and dead-end transitions. Each IDRL iteration runs Dual-RL, corrects the learned ratio into a state-action visitation ratio, and removes zero-weight transitions; after two iterations only near-optimal transitions remain and weighted behavior cloning recovers a path from start to goal.

g.text: Offline dataset: transitions of mixed quality
Iteration 1: Dual-RL ratio w(s,a); drop w = 0
Iteration 2: rerun on what is left; drop w = 0
Weighted BC on the rest → near-optimal policy
